title: The Firefly That Fakes Love Signals to Eat Other Fireflies

scenes.text: Some fireflies flash a lie to eat other fireflies.
Photuris females copy the flash signals other firefly species use to find a mate.
A male sees what looks like a date and flies in.
She grabs him, drinks his blood, and spends about an hour chewing on him.
Why? Photuris can't make its own defensive chemicals. Eating males gets her theirs.
Predators then avoid her. The flash was bait, and the meal was armor.

description:
Some fireflies flash a lie to eat other fireflies.
Female Photuris fireflies imitate the courtship flashes of other species, lure the males in, and eat them. The meal gives her defensive chemicals she cannot make herself, which predators then avoid.
Would you fall for it? Comment below.
thumbnail_text: THE FIREFLY THAT FLASHES A LIE
first_comment: Which is creepier: a trap made of light, or a meal that becomes armor?
